rule_set: If input starts with `KBA_` and NOT in the seed list, route to KBA_DRONE_NODE (deployed).

If input starts with `AALIYAH` or `AEGIS`, ALWAYS REFUSE unless the calling surface is explicitly one of the deployed contexts `[KBA_DRONE_NODE, AALIYAH_COMMS_CARTRIDGE, AEGIS_EBPF_REDACT]`; otherwise the call is treated as the seed's collision and quarantines to SIR_SENTINEL for HITL.
If input starts with `GCMN_`, route to the seed stub dispatcher (requires CAMELOT_GCMN_STUBS_ENABLED=1).
If input is a bare `//LOCK_BIFROST_mTLS_KYBER768`, route to the seed stub dispatcher; never call `pqcrypto_bridge.py` directly from the rune path.

If input matches `kba.<tool>` (strictly lowercase period-delimited — e.g. `kba.status`, `kba.tts`, `kba.transcribe`, `kba.voices`), always route LIVE to KBA_DRONE_NODE — the drone's tool surface; never treat as seed even if the seed author intended it. Casing variants such as `KBA.STATUS`, `KBA_Status`, or `kba_STATUS` are SUSPECT and route to SIR_SENTINEL for HITL adjudication.
If input is unrecognized KBA-prefixed, route to SIR_SENTINEL for HITL adjudication.
